contentHtml:
Are you looking for authorized business activities in JAFZA? Here, we discuss the details for all permitted activities and information at Jafza. 

JAFZA is a prestigious Free Zone since it is close to the International Airport and the Gulf Port. It is the most significant port in the Middle East. It supports numerous enterprises, including Fortune brands, and gives them access to worldwide marketplaces that no one else can match. It is a center for entrepreneurs from all over the world, with a wide range of business activities, supportive legislation for investors, and outstanding facilities. This complete guide will help you leverage the Jafza activity list to find potential in trading, production, service provision, and other sectors.

FAQs:

What does JAFZA mean?

What is Jafza? The Jebel Ali Free Zone Authority is what JAFZA stands for. It is a lucrative Free Zone in Dubai, and it has established a name for prospects and opportunities around the world. Over the years, JAFZA has been a key player in connecting trade, distribution, and financial networks from all over the world.

Main Advantages of Business Setup in JAFZA

  • You can run your business without having to get a local sponsor.
  • Businesses pay no corporate tax, and they can make the most profits.
  • Workers and business owners are not required to pay personal income tax.
  • You can freely send all of the earnings and funds back to your native country.
  • There are substantial savings on the cost of transferring goods, imports, and exports in the free zone.
  • JAFZA Port has modern facilities, warehouses, and transportation networks.
  • Enjoy fast and easy ways to register your business.
  • Different license activities are available for various kinds of enterprises, such as trading, manufacturing, and service-based companies.
  • Acquire long-term agreements on land and commercial space to give your business stability and consistency.
  • Utilize its advantageous setting and connectivity to get to global and regional markets easily.

What does JAFZA Activity List mean? 

The Jafza activity list groups approved business activities and helps enterprises run smoothly in Dubai’s tax-free economy. The main areas are: 

  • Trading includes retail, e-commerce, and import/export.
  • Production includes spanning a vast range of sectors. 
  • Professional Services, such as consultancy.
  • Transportation services for moving freight and clearing customs.
  • Particular activities and services for the environment and medical care.

This Free Zone continually updates the standards and descriptions that identify activities to keep up with market trends.

Primary Business Activities List in Jafza

There are numerous kinds of business activity at the JAFZA in Dubai. Each category contains a long list of permitted activities, which gives investors more independence. JAFZA divides business licenses into these primary groups:

Trading Activities in JAFZA

A trading license permits businesses to purchase, sell, and distribute goods.

  • General trading and retail.
  • Trading in cars and auto spare parts.
  • Trading in medications and health care supplies. 
  • Trading in material for construction and hardware. 
  • Trading in electronic products and home appliances.

Industrial/Manufacturing Activities in JAZA

An Industrial License is available to enterprises that manufacture, process, or produce products.

  • Processing foods and packaging.
  • Production of medical devices and medications.
  • Assembling electronics and electrical gadgets.
  • Production of clothes and textiles.
  • Creating plastic and metal items. 
  • Recycling goods.

Service Activities in JAFZA

Firms that provide services can get a Service License. It covers consultancy and managerial services.

  • Advertising and promotional agencies.
  • Accounting and finances.
  • Business Consultancy.
  • Education and training.

Logistics & Transportation Activities in JAZA

The transportation license is for businesses that provide logistical and distribution services. It covers things like: 

  • Transporting goods 
  • Warehouse services
  • Shipping and delivery
  • Freight forwarding.

It helps businesses run their logistical services more smoothly and effectively in the Free Zone.

Specialized Activities in JAFZA

Entities that provide specialized services are in this category. It includes:

  • IT firms and developers of software.
  • Engineering & Architectural Services.
  • Healthcare Services.

Primary Business Sectors in JAFZA

This Free Zone is a significant industrial center in Dubai that helps different kinds of businesses. The main industries are: 

  • Automobiles and spare parts.
  • Retail and online shopping.
  • Healthcare.
  • Quick-moving consumer products.
  • Shipment and logistics.
  • Production and manufacturing. 
  • Machinery, tools, and gadgets.
  • Electronic products. 
  • Groceries and food products.

Business Activity Application in JAFZA

You will need to choose the proper activity type from the prescribed Jafza business activity list to apply for a business activity in this Free Zone. You must finish the license and company creation process after you choose the activity for your business.

Figure Out Your Business Activity

To figure out your business activity, you will need to look at the authorized activity list. Your business category must match the list of activities and your business strategies. Next, you need to identify what kind of license you require to operate your business, and choose the license type accordingly.

Necessary Documentation

You need to show the following important documents: 

  • Partners and owners’ passports.
  • Evidence of residency. 
  • Proper business plan regarding activities.
  • Complete application form.
  • NOC (if needed).

Apply Initially

You will need to send your application form, including the business activity you chose, and all necessary papers. The Free Zone authority will look over your first application and ensure you comply with all of its rules.

Initial Approval

If the Free Zone authority is satisfied with your application, you will get the first approval to establish your business. Some sectors will need further clearance and permits from the right authorities.  

Payment for License & Registration

Pay the cost you need to get your license and register your business. The Free Zone authority will give you a valid company license that shows what activities you are permitted to conduct within the Free Zone.

Rental Contract

Determine a workspace or warehouse location and sign a rental agreement. This phase is highly significant as the license needs a real address.

Visas and Other Service Application

You can get work visas, customs authorizations, and other permits you need for your business activities after you get a license.

Business Activities Modifications in JAFZA

You will need to look at the Jafza free zone activity list that is available if you intend to change business activities on your current license.

  • Figure out what business activity is required to add to your license.
  • Check to see if the activity is already on your license.
  • Send an email request or proceed to the customer care desk.
  • You might need permission from the Environment, Healthcare, and Security authorities or other third parties for some actions.
  • For every extra activity that goes beyond the maximum allowed per activity group, there will be an extra cost of AED five hundred.

How KPM PRO Can Assist You with Business Activity in JAFZA

If you select the wrong activity, your plans could get delayed or become inappropriate later. It’s always beneficial to ask an expert before proceeding.

Conclusion

This Free Zone provides enterprises numerous opportunities to thrive in a great, business-friendly setting. It enables firms to prosper around the world and achieve long-term growth.

You may confidently set up your business in the growing free zone since JAFZA has a list of official activities, outstanding amenities, and various license alternatives. You can choose the business activity that best fits your objectives and budget. To get a full list of JAFZA activities, connect with one of our consultants.

FAQs:

Do All Business Activities Open to All Licenses?

Only particular categories of licenses, like trading, commercial, or service licenses, authorize certain activities. You need a suitable license for the activity you choose.

Which authority will approve the activities in JAFZA?

The Free Zone Authority controls and authorizes all business activities. They also work with outside groups like DED, according to the activity type and category.

How to Select the Most Suitable Activity for Your Business?

Choose the activities that fit with the company’s objective and your business plan. To ensure you choose the proper options, it’s recommended to reach out to a business setup professional.

Do I require special permission for particular activities?

Some particular activities, such as healthcare facilities, food businesses, or chemicals, may need further permission from other groups, such as health and security authorities.

Where is Jafza in Dubai?

This Free Zone is located near the nation’s largest seaport and near the Dubai International Airport.
